label: copy phase, early recall in long sequences, after echoing o/a/i/n/r
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (never on original tokens or <DEL>), and only on repeated tokens (in_first=0). The input token is the main driver: in copy steps fed back o, a, or i (lift about 8x), and more weakly n or r; together these hold about 95% of activation mass. It is strongest early in the copy (recall_idx 2-3, about 80% of mass, with a smaller bump at recall_idx 7-8 in L=9) and in long sequences (L=9 holds 58% of mass; L<=5 is almost silent). The strongest examples are o/a fed back at recall_idx 1-2 of length-9 sequences. Within the gated region it fires only on some steps, so precision is limited (dev F1 about 0.49, mass recall 0.68). The other conditions of the predicate are not enough to say which of these steps fire.
